product: Q2 2026 (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K): Xywav $471.2M +13% with about 17,125 active patients, Epidiolex $292.1M +16%, Zepzelca $105.8M +42%, Modeyso $48.2M, Ziihera $15.4M BTC. The incremental demand driver now is Ziihera in first-line HER2+ gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma, approved 2026-08-25 (SEC 8-K).
demand: Volume and patients, not price. Xywav +13% on about 525 net patient adds; Epidiolex +16% on continued demand; Zepzelca +42% on first-line maintenance ES-SCLC uptake partly offset by lower second-line use (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K). High-sodium oxybate AG royalty revenue fell to $42.2M from $54.1M, and no price increase was disclosed (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K).
pricing_power: Higher royalties on Modeyso and Zepzelca plus acquisition inventory step-up already cut GAAP gross margin to 90.4% versus 92.1% non-GAAP (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K). A negative HERIZON-GEA-01 second interim OS, a weak Ziihera launch, or ABS-1230 clinical failure after the $820M Actio outlay (2026-09-15, SEC 8-K) would compress margins and returns.
competition: Closest substitute is biosimilar trastuzumab plus generic chemotherapy in first-line GEA, versus Ziihera (2026-08-25, SEC 8-K). For rare epilepsies, off-label generic alternatives persist. No Chinese low-cost zanidatamab biosimilar found; Chinese tislelizumab (Tevimbra, BeOne) is a partner drug, not a substitute. Not found for a close Chinese clone.
market_strategy: CEO Renee Gala, 2026-08-03: guidance driven by a considerable increase to full-year revenue guidance, raised to $4.60-4.75B, and plans to launch Ziihera in 1L GEA and expand the pipeline (SEC 8-K). On 2026-09-15 she pledged to move with urgency to rapidly advance ABS-1230 (SEC 8-K). 3Q26 promises: Zepzelca 2L labeling supplement and HERIZON-GEA-01 doublet interim OS (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K).
bull: Q2 2026 revenue $1,208.3M up 16% with guidance raised to $4.60-4.75B (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K); Ziihera 1L HER2+ GEA approved 2026-08-25 with OS 26.4 vs 19.2 months; 19 raises from 12 firms in 90 days.
bear: GAAP gross margin 90.4% vs 92.1% non-GAAP on royalties and Actio inventory step-up; $4.4B debt plus $1.1B exchangeable notes; Zepzelca 2L SCLC indication being withdrawn in 3Q26 (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K).
falsifier: A negative second interim overall survival from the HERIZON-GEA-01 doublet, due 3Q26 (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K), would prove the Ziihera 1L growth thesis wrong.
web_what_changed_30_90d: Last 30 days: closed $1.25B of 1.875% exchangeable notes due 2032 plus ~$225M share buyback at $249.29 (2026-08-31, SEC 8-K); completed the $820M Actio Biosciences acquisition adding ABS-1230 (2026-09-15, SEC 8-K); repriced term loan B-2 to B-3 with maturity to 2033 (2026-09-23, SEC 8-K). Last 90 days: FDA approved Ziihera in 1L HER2+ GEA (2026-08-25, SEC 8-K); 2026 revenue guidance raised to $4.60-4.75B (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K).
web_true_now_not_modelled: Ziihera first-line HER2+ GEA revenue only starts after the 2026-08-25 FDA approval, so 2Q26 Ziihera was just $15.4M of BTC sales (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K). Consensus 2026 revenue of $4.72B (2026-09-28, stockanalysis.com) may not fully model the 1L launch, and second interim HERIZON-GEA-01 doublet OS is still due 3Q26 (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K).

web_price_volume_mix: Volume and patients, not price. Xywav +13% on about 525 net patient adds; Epidiolex +16% on continued demand; Zepzelca +42% on first-line maintenance ES-SCLC uptake partly offset by lower second-line use (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K). High-sodium oxybate AG royalty revenue fell to $42.2M from $54.1M, and no price increase was disclosed (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K).
web_bottleneck: Ziihera uptake depends on HER2 testing at diagnosis and on managing severe diarrhea, the most common adverse reaction and a Boxed Warning (2026-08-25, SEC 8-K). Company-side, the bottleneck is balance sheet and mix: $4.4B debt and 90.4% GAAP gross margin versus 92.1% non-GAAP (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K).
web_who_benefits_next: BeOne Medicines (Tevimbra/tislelizumab partner) and Zymeworks (zanidatamab licensor) gain from the Ziihera 1L GEA approval (2026-08-25, SEC 8-K). AbCellera gains from the 2026-08-03 collaboration (SEC 8-K), and the spun-out private entity from Actio retains certain non-ABS-1230 programs (2026-09-15, SEC 8-K). Royalty holders on Modeyso and Zepzelca benefit (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K).
web_who_loses: Trastuzumab-based regimens (Roche/Genentech Herceptin) lose the first-line HER2+ GEA standard of care: Ziihera median OS 26.4 versus 19.2 months and PFS 12.4 versus 8.1 months (2026-08-25, SEC 8-K). Jazz itself concedes second-line Zepzelca use declines and it is withdrawing that 2L SCLC indication in 3Q26 (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K).
web_margin_collapse_risk: Higher royalties on Modeyso and Zepzelca plus acquisition inventory step-up already cut GAAP gross margin to 90.4% versus 92.1% non-GAAP (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K). A negative HERIZON-GEA-01 second interim OS, a weak Ziihera launch, or ABS-1230 clinical failure after the $820M Actio outlay (2026-09-15, SEC 8-K) would compress margins and returns.
web_low_cost_substitute: Closest substitute is biosimilar trastuzumab plus generic chemotherapy in first-line GEA, versus Ziihera (2026-08-25, SEC 8-K). For rare epilepsies, off-label generic alternatives persist. No Chinese low-cost zanidatamab biosimilar found; Chinese tislelizumab (Tevimbra, BeOne) is a partner drug, not a substitute. Not found for a close Chinese clone.
web_ceo_promised: CEO Renee Gala, 2026-08-03: guidance driven by a considerable increase to full-year revenue guidance, raised to $4.60-4.75B, and plans to launch Ziihera in 1L GEA and expand the pipeline (SEC 8-K). On 2026-09-15 she pledged to move with urgency to rapidly advance ABS-1230 (SEC 8-K). 3Q26 promises: Zepzelca 2L labeling supplement and HERIZON-GEA-01 doublet interim OS (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K).
web_did_they_deliver: Yes so far. 16% Q2 revenue growth with a guidance raise (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K); Ziihera 1L GEA approved on the 2026-08-25 PDUFA date (SEC 8-K); Actio acquisition closed 2026-09-15 (SEC 8-K); term loan repriced 2026-09-23 (SEC 8-K). Outstanding: the 3Q26 Zepzelca 2L SCLC withdrawal filing and the HERIZON-GEA-01 doublet interim OS.
web_what_would_falsify: A 2026 revenue print below the $4.60B guidance floor (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K), or a negative second interim overall survival from the HERIZON-GEA-01 doublet due 3Q26 (2026-08-03, SEC 8-K), would falsify the thesis. So would a failed Zepzelca 2L SCLC withdrawal filing or an ABS-1230 setback after the $820M Actio deal (2026-09-15, SEC 8-K).
